content.short: DyorSwap is a multichain decentralized exchange deployed on Plasma, Stable and Unichain.
content.description: DyorSwap is a decentralized exchange that began on Mode and has since deployed across several newer networks, including Plasma, Stable and Unichain. Its footprint follows a common pattern for smaller DEXes: launching early on emerging chains where liquidity is still forming, rather than competing for share on established ones.
